title: 6 Ways AI is Revolutionizing Scientific Discovery (Beyond Just Data Analysis)
angle: This listicle spotlights how AI is moving beyond traditional data processing to actively automate research replication, accelerate drug discovery, and enhance medical calculations, presenting a holistic view of AI's transformative role in science.
rationale: Stories 2, 3, 6, and 12 showcase various impactful applications of AI in scientific research, which lends itself well to a structured list.
